mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 7.0% triggers labor market strengthening, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses below 7.0%, or the effect persists only in non-recessionary regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indicate robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite both GDPC1 and HOUST rising, or the correlation between proxies and returns falls below 0.3 in a rolling IC analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals higher policy rates, compressing discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS rises in a tightening cycle, or the regime is not a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects improved supply-side capacity, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises, or the effect is confined to supply shocks rather than structural improvement.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time surge in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 13,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals temporary demand acceleration, driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when GDPC1 exceeds 13,000, or the effect is only temporary and reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Opposing trends in employment (PAYEMS up) and unemployment (UNRATE down) indicate labor market recovery, strengthening investor confidence and producing positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite PAYEMS up and UNRATE down, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 signals supply-side normalization, fostering market optimism and positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not positive when INDPRO exceeds 95.0 in a post-shock recovery regime, or the effect is limited to specific sectors.
